Ella Langley is No.1 on Spotify's US daily chart with "Choosin' Texas" (1,009,611 streams, Nov 13, 2026), 393 days after it first charted. It was No.11 on Oct 31.

The same day, "Here Then We're Gone", her song on The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping (The Album, out Nov 13), debuted at No.55 with 407,293 streams. With "Be Her" (No.34) and "weren't for the wind" (No.36) that's four Ella Langley songs on the US chart at once. 31.5M monthly listeners.

Is Ella Langley the biggest name in country right now?
